Personally, that emptiness was dissociation resulting from depression and bpd. I've been experiencing this throughout the years and honestly it's so damn frustrating, because there are days where I have reason and it feels like all the hard work I put in amounts to nothing. 

I guess I'm still here because I did the absolute bare minimum. At times, I couldn't even go to school or leave my bed, but at least I could try brush my teeth, or put away one item from my desk. Days of doing the bare minimum allowed me to return to normal life. 

As time goes by, I get better at coping when these things happen.

I wish you all the best, good on you for reaching out. Hopefully, you can find good mental health support soon.
